claims.text: Decreases cerebral and cranial nerve inflammation and edema; start it when therapy starts
claims.quote: Dexamethasone is used to decrease cerebral and cranial nerve inflammation and edema; it should be given when therapy is started.

claims.text: Adults 10 mg IV; children 0.15 mg/kg IV; given immediately before or with the first antibiotic dose, then every 6 h for 4 days
claims.quote: Adults are given 10 mg IV; children are given 0.15 mg/kg IV. Dexamethasone is given immediately before or with the initial dose of antibiotics and every 6 hours for 4 days.
Use of dexamethasone is best-established for patients with pneumococcal meningitis (2).
